description: This header file defines the interface and classes for a GStreamer source component within the Rialto media server. It includes class declarations for GstSrc and its factory, along with associated methods, properties, and external dependencies related to GStreamer integration, media stream handling, and decryptor factory setup.

classes.name: GstSrcFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and managing instances of GstSrc, including singleton management and thread safety.

classes.name: GstSrc
classes.description: Implementation of the IGstSrc interface, managing GStreamer source setup, initialization, and stream configuration.

methods.name: GstSrcFactory::getGstSrc
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton GstSrc instance.

methods.name: GstSrc::GstSrc
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GstSrc with provided GStreamer and decryptor factories.

methods.name: GstSrc::setupAndAddAppArc
methods.description: Configures and adds an app source to the GStreamer pipeline with decryption and stream info.

methods.name: GstSrc::allAppSrcsAdded
methods.description: Finalizes setup after all app sources have been added.
